0.original: Kageel Ja seeks your aid in further improving Gok Golma.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested materials to Kageel Ja.

48.original: Things around here have become so much busier than when we began, eh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

49.original: Even the Brethren of Br'aax have been known to stop by and stay awhile. It's proven a great spot for them to interact with our customers from Mamook.

50.original: Which is why I want to go one step further and make of the gainery a place where everyone can feel welcomed and relaxed. To that end, I spoke with one of our visitors and learned that the Xbr'aal use a pleasing aroma to create a restful atmosphere.

51.original: The aromatic materials you procured for us were well praised by the Brethren of Br'aax─the scent made them feel right at home.

52.original: As lovely as the aroma is, however, it only lasts for so long... We'll have to make gathering fresh batches a part of our regular duties.

53.original: Should you happen to be in the area, I'm told you can find deposits of aromatic salt north of the dirigible landing. A few pinches should be enough for us to create a welcoming fragrance.

54.original: Should you happen to be in the area, I'm told you can find sweet-smelling white flowers near Yak Awak Tsoly. A few blooms should be enough for us to create a welcoming fragrance.

55.original: Should you happen to be in the area, I'm told you can catch a species of sweetfish at Yak Awak Tsoly. One should be enough for us to create a welcoming fragrance.

56.original: Oh, and be sure to take a supply of golden stonefly nymphs to use as bait.

57.original: If you've time on your hands, the Xbr'aal are said to favor the scent of a certain aromatic salt found north of the dirigible landing.

58.original: If you've time on your hands, the Xbr'aal are said to favor the scent of a certain white flower found near Yak Awak Tsoly.

59.original: If you've time on your hands, the Xbr'aal are said to favor the scent of a certain species of sweetfish found at Yak Awak Tsoly. You should be able to catch them using golden stonefly nymphs as bait.

60.original: Can I assume you've brought our aromatic ingredient?

61.original: I thought as much! I smelled such a pleasant scent as you approached.

62.original: ...Hm, does that mean both Xbr'aal and Mamool Ja are fond of similar smells? We spent so many years in conflict over our differences, but I wonder what else we might have in common.

63.original: Appreciating a calming fragrance is something I'd never considered until the brethren began their visits. Each of our cultures has much to learn from the other.
